description: This Java source file defines a utility class `ApacheFopWorker` for processing XML and XSL-FO files to generate PDF or other formats via Apache FOP. It includes methods for configuring the FOP factory, transforming input files or streams, managing temporary files, and handling encryption and permissions settings.

classes.name: ApacheFopWorker
classes.description: A utility class for transforming XML/XSL-FO to PDF or other formats using Apache FOP, managing configuration, encryption, and temporary files.

methods.name: getFactoryInstance
methods.description: Returns a singleton instance of FopFactory, initializing it with configuration files and font settings.

methods.name: transform
methods.description: Performs transformation of FO files or streams into the specified output format, optionally with a stylesheet.

methods.name: createFopInstance
methods.description: Creates a new Fop instance configured with the specified output stream and format, optionally with an FOUserAgent.

methods.name: createTempFoXmlFile
methods.description: Creates a temporary file for FO XML input, designated for cleanup after use.

methods.name: createTempResultFile
methods.description: Creates a temporary file for transformation results, designated for cleanup after use.
